messages:
Mira Patel: Quick sync 0: scheduling ask: we need a coordinated marketplace + press cadence for upcoming H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi waves. Any absolute blackout or embargo dates from partners in April-May?

Vendor PM - Nvidia: We have a tentative firmware freeze for H100/H200 on 2026-04-21. Can't guarantee beyond a +/- 5 day window yet. Press embargo likely late-April but we're confirming.

Vendor PM - Habana: Gaudi perf team flagged additional microcode tests; they'd like a separate validation window around 2026-04-13-04-19. No hard embargo, just test runway.

Kelvin Cho: For ops: that Nvidia freeze would block any image rebuilds that change driver bundles. MI300 driver parity fix is currently aimed at 2026-05-02 (might move). B200 inventory looks open for early June.

Sofia Alvarez: Marketplace lead times? Alex, what do you need to land a listing if vendor freeze holds?

Alex Kim: Marketplace requires final image + signed EULA + compatibility matrix at least 10 business days before publish for QA/legal. If freeze is 2026-04-21, we need artifacts ~2026-04-07. For mid-May announce we need final by 2026-05-01. Also need vendor attribution strings for legal.

announce-bot: FYI: Embargo-handshake tool updated to support multiple vendor windows per announcement. See /tools/embargo.

Mira Patel: Proposed two-track plan:
- Primary: consolidated announce window 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-17 (waits for MI300 fix)
- Secondary: split announce in late-Apr (H100/B200 small wave) with explicit compatibility caveat if vendors confirm earlier windows

Ryan O'Neal: Legal: We'll need final EULA drafts and OEM trademark lines by 2026-04-09 for primary. Compressed timeline (fallback) needs them by 2026-04-22. Please add vendor legal contacts.

Sophia Li: SI partners want a dry-run to validate drivers and sample inference stacks. Proposed dates: Gaudi/H100 dry-run 2026-04-12, MI300 dry-run 2026-05-05. Dry-run checklist: 
```
- image pull + runtime startup
- kernel-driver compatibility note
- KV-cache warmup smoke
- sample inference pipeline run (latency & correctness)
- logs/tracing plumbing
- GC and memory pressure check
```

Sofia Alvarez: Ops, can you provide lab pools for dry-runs? We need 4-6 nodes/vendor.

Kelvin Cho: Yes. Can carve 6-node pool for 2026-04-12 (Gaudi/H100) and another 6-node pool for MI300 on 2026-05-05. Please file provisioning tickets by EOD Friday.

Alex Kim: I'll reserve marketplace QA slots and create SKU templates. Marketing: avoid overlapping vendor press; ping vendor PMs for press calendars.

Mira Patel: I'll reach out to vendor PMs for press windows and freeze certainty. If Nvidia press collides with late-April big event, we should default to mid-May primary.

Vendor PM - Nvidia: I'll confirm press windows by 2026-03-31 and let you know freeze certainty margin.

Ryan O'Neal: Also request that all listings include this attribution string exactly: "Hardware vendor names and trademarks used with permission." Send vendor legal contacts to me.

Mira Patel: Action items:
- Mira: confirm vendor freeze + press windows by 2026-04-02
- Kelvin: provisioning tickets for dry-run pools by 2026-03-28
- Alex: start SKU templates + block marketing hold dates by 2026-03-30
- Sophia: prepare SI dry-run checklist doc + invite integrators by 2026-03-29
- Ryan: circulate EULA timeline and collect vendor legal contacts by 2026-03-29

Sofia Alvarez: :thumbsup: will coordinate integrator invites after Mira's confirmations.

Alex Kim: :white_check_mark: will sync with marketplace QA.

Mira Patel: Thanks team. If vendors confirm earlier we can accelerate; otherwise assume MI300 fix and Gaudi perf run dictate primary mid-May. Ping in-thread for updates. :rocket:
